key_derivation: Two independent committed sources agree, which is what makes the key safe. [project.scripts] (pyproject.toml:101-104) is the only console-script table in the repo and names all three targets in mitmproxy.tools.main; docs/scripts/options.py:10-14 separately maps the same three tool names to the three Master classes in order to build the per-tool option badges in the docs. The per-tool addon sets are then read directly off each master's constructor, each of which calls addons.add(*addons.default_addons()) first and then its own extras.
